messages:
matthew_eng: quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's on-prem isolation for ACME. root cause looks like a combination of stale VPC peering routes + a race in our isolation shim. i listed proposed actions below — please ack & claim ownership.

anya_prod: thanks matt. can we get an expected timeline for the peering route fix? customer is asking about mitigation window.

leo_sre: i'll own the VPC peering remediation. plan: validate route propagation, add explicit route refresh on peering reconnect, and add an integration test that tears/recreates peering every 30m in staging. ETA: EOW for hotfix, next week for test. @matthew_eng assigning me the task. :thumbsup:

matthew_eng: approved. please add the hotfix to the dedicated deploy pipeline and mark as must-gate for private clusters. put PR link in the thread when ready.

julia_support: i'll draft the customer-facing timeline once we have the hotfix ETA. keeping them in the loop is priority.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-453 | severity: high | owner: leo_sre | status: investigating

leo_sre: quick note on the isolation shim bug — the race happens when the on-prem agent restarts and reapplies isolation rules while the peering is flapping. root cause: missing check for "peer-up" before applying strict isolation. short-term mitigation: delay strict enforcement by 30s after agent startup. i'll include a config flag so customers can opt-in to stricter fail-fast behavior.

anya_prod: good call. does that affect any other customers? we should scan private installs for the flag being enabled.

leo_sre: yes scanning config DB now — will post results. if enabled on any high-risk installs we'll prioritize hotfix.

matthew_eng: action items summary (please confirm):
- leo_sre: implement route refresh + peering test (ETA: EOW hotfix, next-week test)
- leo_sre: add 30s startup delay to isolation enforcement and config flag (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- matthew_eng: add hotfix to dedicated deploy pipeline and create must-gate (ETA: today)
- julia_support: customer timeline draft (ETA: after hotfix ETA confirmed)
- anya_prod: scan private installs for strict-enforce=true and report list (ETA: 24h)

julia_support: ack, will prepare a one-pager with mitigation steps and expected timeline.

leo_sre: scan result: 3 private installs have strict-enforce=true (ACME, BETACORP, INNOVATE). i'll push a prioritization note for ACME first.

anya_prod: confirming ACME is top priority. i'll schedule a sync with their infra lead for tomorrow to explain mitigation plan.

matthew_eng: also log recurring pattern item: we've seen 2 similar isolation incidents in the last 6 months tied to peering flaps. suggest adding a recurring postmortem ticket to track trend and any systemic infra changes.

leo_sre: agreed. creating RFC to propose automatic peering health checks and adding route reconciliation to the runtime. will attach cost/complexity analysis.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-453 updated | owner: leo_sre | status: in-progress

matthew_eng: thanks everyone. please update the INC ticket with PRs and customer comms. i'll follow up in tomorrow's incident triage. :calendar:
